proof_attempt_summary: Proved the uniform profile q log(1+Tq) + Tq^2/(1+Bq) with an explicit total hard-budget policy and an all-policy original purchased-record converse, then strengthened the result to the normalized published-hypothesis intersection. D0.5 mathematics passed with no findings and both cited statements verified; independent terminal-validity review confirmed subfield below the fixed field floor. Practical constants, operational evaluation, and a broader precision criterion remain absent; unconsumed prop:class-location is disclosed editorial ballast, and F/Lean formalization was not launched.
tldr: The raw Horvitz--Thompson experiment has the uniform early-assay precision profile \(q\log(1+Tq)+Tq^2/(1+Bq)\), attained by an explicit causal quadratic-calendar design with at most \(B\) purchases on every path. The same two-sided profile now holds on \(\mathcal E(T,q)\cap\mathcal N(T)\): a half-amplitude capped-column prior preserves every published row-energy condition while counting information only from actually purchased selected records. At \(q=1/4\), this intersection is exactly the normalized finite truncation of Noarov et al.\ all-horizon hypotheses. Only the converse transfers to their larger terminal snapshot. The resulting finite assay thresholds and joint sparse-radius regimes apply to both games. Immediate-feedback rates and adaptive Horvitz--Thompson accounting remain credited inherited results.
gap: Published immediate-feedback Neyman regret and generic label-efficient results do not evaluate the selected-endpoint precision game with a nonrenewable pathwise assay budget and only chronological-prefix energy control. The published fixed-horizon arm-average and pair-energy conditions are distinct; this class strengthens terminal energy to every prefix but omits the per-unit pair-energy floor. The classes are therefore incomparable in the stated nondegenerate domain.
fill: An elementary full-domain resource certificate for \(R(T,q,B)\), with a finite causal joint design and an unrestricted-policy lower bound on its original transcript, determines the number of early labels needed to preserve immediate raw Horvitz--Thompson precision. The signed deficit expectation charges and purchased-record likelihood are the changed proof steps.
